notes:
- Added healing tracking to the meter, combat history, and rift recaps.
- Use the toggle button on any DPS Meter window or an assignable hotkey (via settings) to swap between DPS and healing data.
- All DPS/healing data is logged regardless of which you are viewing.
- Click on a player in the healing chart to see their healing breakdown.
- Added support for hotkey modifiers (e.g. "ctrl", "shift", "alt").
